claims: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission carries a four-person crew on a 10-day journey around the Moon and back.
The Artemis II crew are the first humans to travel toward the Moon since 1972.
Reid Wiseman (NASA) is the Mission Commander of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover (NASA) is the Pilot of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover is the first Black man to travel around the Moon.
Christina Koch (NASA) is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Christina Koch is the first woman to travel around the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency) is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Jeremy Hansen is the first Canadian to fly to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew is testing the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II crew is testing the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket to prepare for future lunar surface missions.
